description: Full-width article photo with a pull quotation and dash attribution set beneath it as a small bold caption, no box or border.

visualCharacteristics.layout: Single column: photo, then the quotation and '– attribution' as a bold 13px caption; no box, border or decorative quote mark.

contentPattern.structure: row 1: photo (image paragraph) followed by quotation paragraph(s); row 2: attribution

usage: NSMAN magazine articles where a photo is captioned with a quotation from the person pictured, e.g. 'Every lap may be an individual effort, but together, our efforts can make waves for better lives.' – Tommy Ang.
reuseGuidance: Use for a photo whose caption is a quotation with attribution. For a plain photo caption without a quote use default content; for a boxed standalone pull quote without a photo use the quote block.
